messages.text: My miner just fried itself

Sorry, that's a rotten thing to happen. Two quick things so I point you the right way.

Which unit is it, and was it ever overclocked or had its firmware modified? Overclocked or tampered units aren't covered, so I need to ask.

If it's a straight failure, it goes through RMA and you get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Also, was it the miner itself or just the PSU? A dead PSU can be replaced on its own, no need to send the whole unit back.
It had sparks coming from it

Unplug it at the wall now, and don't power it back on. Sparks mean something shorted, and that's a fire risk, not something to test again.

Once it's cold, don't open it. Fill in the RMA form and we'll send a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

I'm getting JD, who handles the hardware, onto this too. Which unit is it, and did the sparks come from the miner body or the power supply?
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, that helps. Looks like a BSB board unit with the control board exposed on top.

Keep it unplugged. Get the RMA form in so a label goes out: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

I've put this to JD, who handles the hardware. Fastest way to reach him right now is our Discord, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf He'll also answer here or by email.

Was it running stock firmware, or had it been overclocked?
Handed to the team · Safety-related hardware failure (sparks) needs JD's assessment; no order number

JD's been pinged and can jump in right here, so stay in the chat if you can. If you step away, you'll get his answer by email.

In the meantime, let me know the firmware question and whether the sparks came from the board or the PSU side, and I'll pass that straight to him.
I moved it so it could get better airflow

Moving it for airflow is fine, that doesn't affect your cover. Only overclocking or modifying the hardware does.

So the one thing I still need is whether the firmware was ever overclocked or tuned above stock, or left as it came.

Get the RMA form in now either way, it starts the label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

JD's seen the photo and can pick this up here or on Discord.
No

Good, stock firmware keeps it straightforward.

Fill in the RMA form and you'll get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform Processing runs up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse.

JD has the photo and can answer here, or faster on Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf post in the server and mention @nullhashrate.

Anything else you want me to pass on about how it failed?
Not that I can think of
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: where was it running before you moved it for airflow?
I had other miners kinda close to one another and made a new self to spread them out so the heat to move out of the way easier
That's useful, thanks. Were all of those miners running off the same outlet or power strip when it sparked?
No

Good to know, I'll pass that to JD with the photo.

Get the RMA form in when you have a minute and the label follows: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Keep it unplugged until then. Thanks for the detail.
I got the miner all packed up

Nice one. One thing before it goes anywhere: don't send it without the return label, or the warehouse can't match it to you.

Submit the RMA form and the label comes back to you by email: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Have you filled that in yet? If you have and the label hasn't landed, tell me and I'll chase it.
Yes it is sent in

That's everything on your side then. The label comes by email, print it, stick it on and drop it off.

Once the unit reaches the warehouse, processing runs up to 10 days.

If the label hasn't shown up in a day or so, check spam first, then come back here and I'll chase it for you.
Ok

You're all set. JD has the photo and the details if he wants to weigh in, here or on Discord.

Hope the rest of the rig keeps humming.
I’m on discord now
Perfect. Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD. Drop the same photo in and mention the sparks and that it's gone in for RMA, he'll pick it up from there.
